actus.title: Pierre Leboucher : “it is a completely magic course! ”
actus.excerpt: Beneath a sun as radiant as the smile he wears, Pierre Leboucher crossed the finish line in third place aboard his Class40, *Institut Imagine*. A podium finish in the Route du Rhum and a Jules Verne Trophy—both in the same year—make for an impressive calling card for his next project: the 2028 Vendée Globe.
